product.description:
Get the ultimate in Air Cooking technology and bring fresh options to family dinner this 30-inch, high speed preheat 5 cu ft gas range. Quickly access spills on the cooktop with industry-first, dishwasher safe EZ-2-Lift™ Hinged cast-iron grates. Get crispy and save time with No Preheat Air Fry, and go from gooey to golden and bake evenly on multiple racks with Air Baking. Plus, you can stay on top of the latest cooking features and unlock new ones over time with Smart Feature updates.

Features:

  • 5 cu. ft. capacity meets the needs of today's busy homes
  • This range comes equipped with 5 sealed burners
  • Touch controls are precise and easy to use
  • Range includes viewing window, broil element, and storage drawer
  • Enjoy plenty of space to sauté?, boil and simmer with Edge-to-Edge Cast-Iron Grates and the flexibility of a cooktop with a range of burner sizes and power levels
  • Use the Steam Clean setting to quickly and easily loosen light messes inside the oven without harsh chemicals or cleaners—just add water, run the cycle and wipe away
  • For easy cleaning, put the included dishwasher-safe air fry basket right in the dishwasher when it gets messy
  • Easy to clean exterior resists fingerprints and smudges
  • Covered under a 1 year limited parts and labor manufacturer warranty

Product Technologies:

  • Air Baking: Go from gooey to golden and get even results when baking on multiple racks with Air Baking. The high-speed fan optimizes air flow and drives consistent heat throughout the oven. Get golden results on breads, pastries and more.
  • Air Broil: Melt, char and sear in a snap with Air Broil. The high-speed fan drives intense heat directly to the top of the oven. Prepare juicy chops, crispy vegetables and gooey s'mores with the added power of intense air-driven heat.
  • Air Cooking Technology: Get the ultimate Air Cooking technology and bring fresh options to family dinner with No Preheat Air Fry, Air Baking, Air Broil, Air Roast and Air Reheat
  • Air Reheat: Skip microwaving and add crispness to leftovers like pizza with Air Reheat. The high-speed fan drives heat to quickly bring food up to temp.
  • Air Roast: Seal in flavors and juices for meat and poultry with Air Roast. The high-speed fan drives air flow to optimize heat through longer cook times. Enjoy the full flavor of hearty dishes like pot roast and whole chicken.
  • EZ-2-Lift™ Hinged Cast-Iron Grates: Get quick access to spills with industry-first, dishwasher safe EZ-2-Lift™ Hinged cast-iron grates. The hinged design lets you wipe up underneath without the hassle of removing heavy grates.
  • SpeedHeat™ Burner: Use the SpeedHeat Burner to boil 20% faster* with high heat, so you can get dinner to the table quickly (*compared to 9.5K burner on the same model)
  • Smart Range: When you’re busy elsewhere, use your smartphone to get dinner started by remotely preheating the oven. Or, when your hands are full, use your compatible voice-enabled device to adjust the cook time or temperature with a voice command (appliance must be set to remote enable - WiFi and app required).
  • No Preheat Mode: Take preheating off your plate with No Preheat Mode. Simply place your food in the oven and start baking. The oven will adjust the cook time for frozen pizzas and more.

Specifications:

  • Total Capacity: 5 Cu. Ft.
  • Back Left Burner BTU: 10,000
  • Back Right Burner BTU: 5,000
  • Front Left Burner BTU: 18,000
  • Front Right Burner BTU: 18,000
  • Broil Element: Yes
  • Convection: No
  • Sabbath Mode: Yes
  • Self Cleaning: Yes
  • Depth: 29-3/16"
  • Height: 38-3/16"
  • Width: 29-7/8"
